entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this piece of junk you sent me. This is absolutely ridiculous.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. So I can best assist, what specifically is the issue with the item?
The issue is that this jersey I bought is completely the wrong size! I ordered a medium and it's so tight I can barely breathe. It's useless! I want my money back, now.
Okay, I understand. Just to clarify, the item itself isn't damaged or defective, the problem is that it's too tight and you need a different size?
What are you not getting? Yes! It's the wrong size! Are you going to help me or do I need to speak to your manager? I'm about to leave a one-star review everywhere I can find.

I understand your frustration, and there's no need for a manager. I can absolutely help you with an exchange. Our jerseys have a 10-day return and exchange policy, so you are unfortunately outside the timeframe. We can get a larger size sent out to you right away.
Fine. Just do it. Don't make this complicated. How does the exchange work?
It's a very simple process. I just need your order number. I'll then generate a pre-paid return shipping label and email it directly to you. You can use that to send back the jersey that's too tight.
My order number is VF90210. Send the email now. I'm waiting.

Thank you. Pulling that up... Okay, I see the order. I have just sent the return label to the email address on file. Once the tracking shows the original item is on its way back to us, we will immediately ship out the new size for you. Would you like a large?
Yes, a large. I got the email. Okay. This is what you should have done in the first place.
I'm glad we could get this sorted out for you. Your new jersey will be on its way shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Just make sure it actually ships.
We certainly will. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
